fusions.name: Torpid Maul
fusions.desc: A swipe that deals 32 damage and leaves the target 18% easier to wound for 8 seconds, with a 60% chance of [Hindered] for 6 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Woken Early
fusions.desc: Swipes a forepaw across a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 11 damage and knocking each enemy back 3 tiles, with a 50% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Brumation
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you regain 12 health at once.

fusions.name: Winter Fat
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 14 and your armour by 5%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
